name: gizza-ai/vectorize
summary: Trace a raster image into a scalable SVG.

tool.description: Trace a raster image (logo, sketch, icon) into a clean, scalable SVG. Provide the image as a `url` (http/https) or a `ref` to an uploaded attachment. Returns the SVG for inline display and download. Use this when the user asks to vectorize / convert an image to SVG / make a logo scalable.

url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL of the raster image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF) to vectorize.

ref.description: Reference id of an uploaded image attachment to vectorize (alternative to url).

mode.description: Trace mode: 'color' (default, multi-color logos/icons) or 'bw' (black-and-white sketches/line art).

color_precision.description: Color-channel precision in color mode, 1-8 (default 6). Higher = more colors/detail, larger SVG.

filter_speckle.description: Discard speckles smaller than this (default 4). Higher = cleaner output.
